title: hieracium nigrescens subsp. subneglectum
intro: Hieracium nigrescens subsp. subneglectum, commonly known as the Black Hawk's Feather or Mountain Hawkweed, is a rare and endangered plant species belonging to the dandelion family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium nigrescens subsp. subneglectum are attributed to its ability to reduce oxidative stress, soothe skin irritations, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a promising natural remedy for wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions are flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified in the plant's leaves and flowers.
